DCR value of each cell shall be computed up to two decimal places. In VoLTE scenario, the performance against this parameter is calculated on QCI=5 bearers dropped abnormally in eNodeB. The corresponding parameter for VoNR i.e QCI flow indicator is captured in gNodeB in 5G Stand Alone (SA) mode. (iii) Organizing the DCR data for measurement of CS_QSD(s, t) and PS_QSD(s, t) (a) Performance of DCR shall be monitored and reported separately for different technologies: a. Voice call in Circuit Switched (CS) network [2G and 3G] through ‘DCR Spatial Distribution Measure for Circuit Switched (2G/3G) network [CS_QSD (s, t)]’ parameter; and b. Voice call in Packet Switched (PS) network [4G, 5G and beyond] through ‘DCR Spatial Distribution Measure for Packet Switched (4G/5G and beyond) network [PS_QSD (s, t)]’ parameter. Where s and t are % of cells and % of days respectively. Applicable values for s and t are as mentioned in regulation 6.
